correctness.rationale: Conditional spherical-coordinate normalization yields Gram density c_d det(G)^((d-4)/2) supported on PSD correlations. z_i=sqrt(d)r_i gives log-density relative to three independent standard normals with cubic term z1 z2 z3/sqrt(d) plus Gaussian-integrable O(poly(||z||)/d) error in the central ball ||z||<=d^(1/16). Marginal sphere concentration bounds both true and signed reference tails by exp(-c d^(1/8)). Gamma ratio normalization has only O(1/d) error. Orthant integrals of zi phi(zi) equal +/-phi(t), converting cubic term to the same positive phi(t)^3/sqrt(d) for max and complement-of-min, with threshold -sqrt(d)sin(t/sqrt(d))=-t+O_T(1/d).

value.rationale: The exact leading constant for a dependent three-edge spherical-graph triangle event, and its total-variation-strength joint approximation, fill a meaningful quantitative gap beyond mere order bounds and marginal/pairwise independence. final_claim: For three independent uniform directions on S^(d-1), as d->infinity the max and min geodesic side CDFs have the same first correction phi(t)^3/sqrt(d), uniform for bounded t, with an underlying L1 signed cubic Gaussian joint-density expansion and O(1/d) integrated remainder.
limitations: Exactly three iid spherical directions and fixed bounded normalized t as d increases; not increasing vertex count, moderate deviations, or general spherical-graph motif counts.
